note: In cyclic loading, a component fails by fatigue when the applied stress amplitude exceeds its endurance limit. The examined axle experienced a stress amplitude of 420 MPa, whereas its endurance limit was measured at 380 MPa. Its fracture surface exhibited beach marks, which are diagnostic of progressive fatigue crack growth rather than a single overload event. The axle therefore failed by fatigue.
